# Equation index (generated -- do not edit)

`WIKI_DRAFT.md` tags each equation with its `EQUATIONS.md` number; the
build renumbers them (1)...(N) in reading order. This is the mapping, so
a number on the published page can still be traced to the function that
evaluates it. Regenerated by `build_wiki_html.py` and
`build_wiki_docx.py`.
